name: Revisions ES module outputs — atomic LFS hydration and bounded durable close; measured 108425 bytes brotli on macOS, 2026-10-21; cross-device chat handoff (XD3/XD4: a chat's checkout resolved from its branch and opened on demand, removed checkouts remembered on the device, and the turn-placement `publish` verb for a live run's heartbeat) about 0.9 kB, 109.32 kB brotli on Linux, 2026-10-23, then 109.42 kB with a missing branch waited on only while a remote syncs and an atomic removed-checkout record (limit raised from 108.6 kB to 109.6 kB with the owner's approval), then 109.70 kB brotli on Linux, 2026-10-23, with a branch a pull deletes recorded removed, a replayed admission answered before placement work, and a bounded wait for a branch's checkout to open (limit raised from 109.6 kB to 110.0 kB with the owner's approval);
